name: Whirling 二楼走廊
blurb: 推门出来，那间砸烂的房在身后合上了。二楼走廊昏暗、有霉味，几扇紧闭的门一字排开；尽头一架楼梯向下，沉进更深的暗里。楼下是食堂，是 Garte，是那笔没付的房费——再往外，就是案发现场。楼梯向下，案子在那底下等着。

points.label: 走廊里抽烟的那个女人
3 号房——检查 Klaasje 留下的窗线索
points.show_when: (Variable["whirling.klaasje_viscal_see_window_hint"] == true or Variable["TASK.inspect_window"] == true) and Variable["TASK.inspect_window_done"] == false

points.label: 3 号房门（Klaasje Amandou）
points.show_when: Variable["whirling.klaasjeone_greeting_done"] == true and Variable["whirling.klaasje_exit_to_room"] == true and Variable["whirling.klaasjedoor_opened"] == false

points.label: 上楼到屋顶见 Klaasje
points.show_when: Variable["whirling.klaasjedoor_opened"] and Variable["TASK.interrogate_klaasje_done"] == false and Variable["TASK.arrest_klaasje_done"] == false
